decisions.reason: Measurement-style units were already required around the bowls; the lighting-location decision does not change those markings.
Locating lighting around the bowls does not necessarily change bowl capacity, depth, geometry, or enclosure-size constraints.
The source's separate button-and-knob styling clauses are already represented by a complete same-message MODIFY; the bowl-lighting decision requires no further edit.
The source does not change the established beige body, green accents, or support-base colors.
Lighting around the bowls does not necessarily alter their quick-removal, clearance, or swapping behavior.
The source does not address the support-base logo, leaf treatment, font, or letter case.
The client only expresses interest in exploring an already established K-button idea and does not necessarily modify its text, style, coverage, or color.
The bowl-lighting location does not affect the machine placard's wording, position, or viewing orientations.
The visual placement of accent lighting does not change mixing quality, foam, whisk selection, or whisk positioning requirements.
The source does not change splash targets or acceptable splash-mitigation methods.
Lighting around the bowls does not necessarily alter dispensing controls, flow behavior, valve selection, or dispensing sequence.
The client requests a visual lighting location but does not necessarily revise the finalized component BOM or require a specific new component.
